editorial.title: Who Is Vishal Sikka? The AI Pioneer Who Ran Infosys — and Just Raised $85 Million to Disrupt It
editorial.excerpt: Nine years after a bruising exit from Infosys, the 59-year-old former SAP CTO has founded Hang Ten Systems, an enterprise AI startup that closed $85 million in seed funding in four months — with Intel and Micron's CEOs writing checks.
editorial.image_caption: Vishal Sikka speaking at SAP's SAPPHIRE conference in Orlando in 2010, when he was the company's first-ever CTO. In 2026 he founded Hang Ten Systems, an enterprise AI startup that has raised $85 million in seed funding.
editorial.nri_angle: Sikka's arc — small-town Madhya Pradesh to Stanford mentorship under AI's founding fathers to the top of Infosys and SAP, and now a founder again at 59 — embodies the Indian diaspora's outsize role in the AI era.

just_in.title: Tourism Secretary Chairs Industry Talks on India's Travel Sector Woes
just_in.excerpt: Bhuvnesh Kumar’s consultation with the travel trade comes as the ministry pushes ease-of-doing-business reforms and presses the industry to spread demand beyond overcrowded hotspots.
just_in.image_caption: Industry leaders on stage at the 7th HAI Hoteliers’ Conclave in New Delhi. Tourism Secretary Bhuvnesh Kumar has chaired a fresh industry consultation on the challenges facing the travel and tourism sector.
just_in.nri_angle: NRIs planning visits home benefit directly: visa categories are down from 22 to nine, e-visa covers 171 countries, and the ministry’s demand-spreading push means more bookable itineraries beyond the usual circuits.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Russia Welcomes India's Ceasefire Push as Kyiv Weighs Truce Proposal
just_in.excerpt: Kyiv called India’s proposal the broadest of four ceasefire offers, covering energy infrastructure and the Black Sea — as Moscow publicly embraced New Delhi’s diplomatic role.
just_in.image_caption: A composite photo showing Prime Minister Narendra Modi with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy (left) and with Russian President Vladimir Putin (right). Kyiv and Moscow both publicly welcomed India’s ceasefire proposal this week.
just_in.nri_angle: India’s rising diplomatic weight — publicly acknowledged by both Moscow and Kyiv — is a marker of status for the diaspora, while any ceasefire progress would ease the energy-price shocks of the past four years.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Opposition 'Vote Theft' Protests Cloud Modi's 25-Year Milestone
just_in.excerpt: Narendra Modi marked a quarter-century in public office with a new “We will do it” rallying cry, even as Delhi police fortified the Election Commission of India against another day of opposition protests over voter-list revisions.
just_in.image_caption: Prime Minister Narendra Modi speaks at a podium during a public event. Modi marked 25 years in public office on October 7, 2026, with the Viksit Bharat Sankalp Sabha in New Delhi.
just_in.nri_angle: The milestone showcases Modi’s political endurance for the diaspora’s most-watched leader, while the opposition’s electoral-integrity campaign shapes how Indians abroad discuss Indian democracy.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: CJI to Decide Fate of Plea to Recall Split Verdict on Election Commission Law
just_in.excerpt: A curative plea argues Justice Satish Chandra Sharma’s undisclosed family link to the Election Commission vitiates the September 23 split verdict on the CEC appointment law — and only the Chief Justice can decide what happens next.
just_in.image_caption: Justice Surya Kant, the Chief Justice of India, will decide how the Supreme Court handles the curative plea against part of its September 23 split verdict on the Election Commissioners appointment law.
just_in.nri_angle: The Supreme Court’s handling of the election-chief appointment law tests the credibility of the institution that runs the world’s largest election — a matter of direct interest to NRIs watching Indian democracy from abroad.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Kashmir on a Plate: What the Swiss President Ate at Rashtrapati Bhavan
just_in.excerpt: President Droupadi Murmu's October 6 banquet for Guy Parmelin served a Kashmiri-Ladakhi spread — Nadur Kebab, Dum Oluv, Shufta and more — during his three-day India visit.
just_in.image_caption: Swiss President Guy Parmelin poses with President Droupadi Murmu at Rashtrapati Bhavan. The October 6 state banquet served a Kashmiri-Ladakhi menu including Nadur Kebab, Dum Oluv, and Shufta.
just_in.nri_angle: The Kashmiri-Ladakhi banquet showcased regional Indian cuisine as soft power, giving the diaspora a proud, specific culinary identity to share abroad.

just_in.title: From Rented Cows to ₹2.4 Crore: Jaipur Couple's Gir Dairy Dream
just_in.excerpt: Vibhor and Ishita Jain started Kinaya Organic Farms in 2018 with no farming experience. Today it runs 100 Gir cows and sells A2 milk and bilona ghee.
just_in.image_caption: Gir cows, the indigenous breed at the heart of Kinaya Organic Farms near Jaipur. The Jain family's herd of 100 Gir cows produces 250-300 litres of A2 milk daily.
just_in.nri_angle: The Jaipur couple's desi-cow dairy model shows NRI investors and returning professionals a working template for premium, sustainable agribusiness in India.

just_in.title: Thousands of Minnesotans May Be Canadian Citizens Without Knowing It
just_in.excerpt: A change to Canada's Citizenship Act that took effect in December 2025 removed the first-generation limit — and with it, the cap on how far back claims can run.
just_in.image_caption: The Minneapolis skyline seen from the Stone Arch Bridge. More than 47,000 Minnesotans report Canadian or French Canadian ancestry, and a December 2025 law change may make many of them dual Canadian-American citizens.
just_in.nri_angle: The C-3 change directly affects Indian-Canadian families who moved to the US: US-born children of Canadian citizens, once cut off by the first-generation limit, may now already be Canadian citizens.

just_in.title: Pramod Bhagat, Bhavina Patel to Lead India at Asian Para Games
just_in.excerpt: The two Tokyo Paralympic medallists will carry the tricolour at the opening ceremony in Nagoya as India sends 121 athletes to the October 18–24 Games.
just_in.image_caption: Para-badminton star Pramod Bhagat, Tokyo 2020 Paralympic gold medallist, will carry India's flag alongside table-tennis medallist Bhavina Patel at the Aichi-Nagoya 2026 Asian Para Games opening ceremony.
just_in.nri_angle: The Indian diaspora in Japan gets a rare home-soil chance to support the country's para-athletes in person at the Aichi-Nagoya Games.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Chennai's 'Wall of Hope' Gives Young Voices a Canvas on Mental Health
just_in.excerpt: The youth-led installation, unveiled at the IIT Madras Research Park by SCARF's Department of Youth Mental Health, opens days ahead of World Mental Health Day.
just_in.nri_angle: The youth-led mental health wall at IIT Madras Research Park reflects a stigma-fighting model that matters to NRI families worried about pressures on young people both in India and abroad.

just_in.title: Oman Evacuates Injured Crew From Tanker Struck in Hormuz Attack
just_in.excerpt: Twelve of the MT On Peace's 19 crew were injured, including 11 Indians, in the latest of at least seven tanker attacks near the strait in early October; India condemned the strike and thanked Oman.
just_in.image_caption: Cargo ships and a small boat move through open water in the Gulf region. Twelve of the 19 crew of the Panama-flagged MT On Peace were injured when the tanker was struck by a projectile while transiting the Strait of Hormuz on Monday.
just_in.nri_angle: Eleven of the 12 injured crew are Indian nationals, underscoring how often Indian seafarers — who form a large share of global shipping crews — are caught in the crossfire of attacks on Gulf shipping lanes.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Gold Coils Below $4,150 as Markets Await the Fed's Minutes
just_in.excerpt: Bullion slipped as the dollar and Treasury yields climbed, with traders pricing an 85% chance of a December rate hike ahead of the September FOMC minutes.
just_in.image_caption: A dollar symbol rests on a golden weighing pan. Gold eased to $4,150 an ounce on Wednesday as a stronger dollar and rising Treasury yields pressured the metal ahead of the Federal Reserve meeting minutes.
just_in.nri_angle: For Indian investors, the global pullback contrasts with strong domestic festive-season demand — with 24-karat gold around Rs 1.49 lakh per 10 grams in India, how much of that demand offsets macro headwinds will shape the metal's next move.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: FIR Filed After Rahul, Priyanka Gandhi Sit-In at Akashvani Bhawan
just_in.excerpt: Delhi Police booked the Gandhi siblings and INDIA bloc MPs for forcibly entering the premises during Tuesday's march against the Election Commission, after an eight-hour dharna that saw around 260 protesters detained.
just_in.image_caption: Rahul Gandhi and Priyanka Gandhi Vadra sit with fellow MPs under a tree inside the Akashvani Bhawan premises in New Delhi. The leaders staged an eight-hour dharna after police stopped the INDIA bloc march toward the Election Commission headquarters on Tuesday.
just_in.nri_angle: Election-integrity battles are among the most closely followed Indian political stories in the diaspora, where the imagery of Rahul Gandhi waving the tricolour atop a police barricade is likely to dominate NRI political conversation for days.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Gradiant Wins Five India Contracts as Chip Boom Turns on Water
just_in.excerpt: The Boston water-technology company named a new India chief and will expand its Indian workforce by more than 40 percent as it supplies ultrapure water and zero-liquid-discharge systems to semiconductor, circuit-board and solar factories.
just_in.image_caption: Precision equipment works on a semiconductor wafer during chip fabrication. Gradiant won five new contracts to supply ultrapure water and zero-liquid-discharge systems to chip, circuit-board and solar factories in India.
just_in.nri_angle: Gradiant's expansion adds deep-tech engineering roles in India — including at its Coimbatore center that serves global projects — at the intersection of the country's chip ambitions and diaspora tech careers.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.nri_angle: For diaspora families traveling between the US and India, the outbreak is a practical warning to check MMR vaccination records before flying, since measles spreads easily in airports and on planes.

news.title: Jaishankar Meets Ghana's Mahama as Accra Courts Indian Pharma Investment
news.excerpt: Opening a five-day tour of Ghana, Côte d'Ivoire and Ethiopia, the foreign minister's Accra visit centred on pharmaceuticals, agriculture and industrialisation — with Mahama pitching a rebounding economy to Indian investors.
news.image_caption: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar speaks at a diplomatic meeting. He met Ghana's President John Mahama in Accra on Tuesday at the start of a five-day tour of Ghana, Côte d'Ivoire and Ethiopia.
news.nri_angle: Ghana hosts a long-standing Indian business community; Indian pharma firms are already the biggest suppliers of affordable medicines to West Africa, and Mahama's pitch could open new manufacturing partnerships for diaspora entrepreneurs.

news.title: Union Cabinet Gives Modi Standing Ovation, Passes Resolution Marking 25 Years in Office
news.excerpt: The cabinet resolution traces ten threads from Modi's Gujarat years to national policy — and came alongside approval of a Rs 10,000 crore SME Growth Fund and a new national transport authority.
news.image_caption: Prime Minister Narendra Modi. The Union Cabinet passed a resolution congratulating him on 25 years of continuous leadership as head of government.
news.nri_angle: For the diaspora, the milestone frames a leader many NRIs have watched transform from a regional figure into a global statesman; the 25-year narrative will shape how India's story is told to the world in the years ahead.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Nobel Physics Prize Goes to Francis Halzen for Capturing 'Ghost Particles' From Deep Space
news.excerpt: The Belgian physicist's decades-long project — thousands of light sensors buried in Antarctic ice — opened a new kind of astronomy based on neutrinos, the elusive 'ghost particles' of the cosmos.
news.image_caption: Physicist Francis Halzen poses for a portrait. He won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics for his work on the IceCube Neutrino Observatory and the discovery of high-energy neutrinos from deep space.
news.nri_angle: Pure global science news with no direct diaspora impact; noted briefly as a milestone in international big science that Indian science students and researchers follow closely.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: IIT Bombay Rolls Out Wellness, Hostel and Exam Reforms After Student Suicide Row
news.excerpt: After weeks of protests following a student's death, the institute promises twin-sharing hostels for all years, wall-mounted fans, postponed mid-semester exams, and a student-led rewrite of invigilation rules.
news.image_caption: IIT Bombay campus in Powai, Mumbai. The institute has rolled out wellness, hostel and exam reforms after the death of second-year student Sahil Wakode on September 18.
news.nri_angle: Thousands of diaspora families send children to IITs each year; the safety and exam reforms directly affect NRI parents weighing Indian higher education and IIT Bombay's standing as India's flagship technology institute.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Serum Institute's Cervavac Gets WHO Prequalification, Opening Path to UN Vaccine Supply
news.excerpt: The Pune-made, gender-neutral HPV vaccine's WHO prequalification is Serum Institute's 32nd and makes CERVAVAC eligible for procurement by UN agencies for immunization programs worldwide.
news.image_caption: Vaccine vials. Serum Institute's Cervavac has received WHO prequalification, opening the path to wider global supply.
news.nri_angle: With an India-made, WHO-prequalified HPV vaccine eligible for UN procurement, Indian families everywhere gain an affordable path to protecting both daughters and sons against HPV-related cancers — and India's own immunization program may follow with a domestic rollout.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: New York Declares Measles Disaster Emergency as Rural Outbreak Spreads to 18 Counties
news.excerpt: Governor Kathy Hochul declared a statewide disaster emergency on October 5 after 108 measles cases this year, expanding who can test and vaccinate as the US endures its worst measles year since 1991.
news.image_caption: A measles alert sign posted at Cohen Children's Medical Center in New York lists symptoms — fever, rash, cough and red eyes — and instructs symptomatic patients to wear a mask and report to the front desk. New York’s governor declared a statewide disaster emergency on October 5 as measles cases spread across 18 rural counties.
news.nri_angle: Indian-American families in New York and New Jersey, many in the suburban and upstate counties hit by the outbreak, should check their children's two-dose MMR vaccination records as the state pushes an emergency vaccination drive through November 4.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: India, UAE Launch Third Mountain Guardian Exercise in Uttarakhand Hills
news.excerpt: The fortnight-long exercise, running October 5–18 at the Foreign Training Node in Chaubatia, brings 92 troops from both armies together for mountain warfare drills including drone operations and surveillance-grid training.
news.image_caption: Indian and UAE servicewomen pose during Exercise Mountain Guardian in Uttarakhand. Ninety-two personnel from both armies are training together at Chaubatia from October 5 to 18, with a focus on mountain warfare.
news.nri_angle: The UAE hosts one of the world's largest overseas Indian communities, and a deeper military partnership adds a hard-security pillar to a relationship that already binds the two countries on trade, energy, and people-to-people ties.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Pune Lab's HPV Self-Sampling Kit Aims to Expand Cervical Cancer Screening
news.excerpt: Greenarray Labs has launched CerviSens, a vaginal self-sampling kit for high-risk HPV testing that skips the speculum exam. A 203-sample validation study reported 98.0% sensitivity and 99.4% specificity versus clinician collection.
news.image_caption: Greenarray Labs representatives at the launch of CerviSens, the company’s HPV self-sampling kit, in Pune. The kit allows women to collect their own vaginal sample for high-risk HPV testing without a speculum examination.
news.nri_angle: Many NRI families arrange health checkups for relatives in India; a validated self-sampling option is worth flagging to women back home who have skipped cervical screening, and India's screening gap is a known concern in diaspora health philanthropy.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: US Marine Arrested After Strangling Death of Japanese Woman in Okinawa
news.excerpt: Lance Corporal Devin Jacob Ballard, 20, was arrested on suspicion of murder and robbery after Anna Yagi, 39, was found dead in a Naha hotel room. Japan's prime minister lodged a formal protest and demanded full US cooperation.
news.nri_angle: The case will be watched in New Delhi, where India's deepening defence ties with the United States and Japan run through the Quad — and where past Okinawa incidents have fed public debate about the costs host communities pay for foreign military presence.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: BJP drops Hardeep Puri, Smriti Irani in fresh UP Rajya Sabha slate of 8
news.excerpt: The BJP announced an entirely new slate for the October 16 biennial elections to ten Rajya Sabha seats from Uttar Pradesh, with no sitting member renominated and two Union ministers left out.
news.image_caption: Hardeep Singh Puri, former Union minister. (Wikimedia Commons)
news.nri_angle: Uttar Pradesh's Rajya Sabha bloc shapes legislation touching the diaspora — emigration, citizenship and fiscal bills — and Puri's exclusion raises the question of who holds the petroleum portfolio, with direct relevance to energy prices.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Thailand floods kill 31 as forecast warns of more rain and flash flooding this week
news.excerpt: The Interior Ministry confirmed 31 deaths from flooding since September 16, as meteorologists forecast thunderstorms and heavy rain across upper Thailand through Wednesday.
news.image_caption: Floodwaters in Hat Yai, Songkhla province, during Thailand's 2010 floods — file photo. (Wikimedia Commons)
news.nri_angle: Thailand is a top destination for Indian travellers and home to a large Indian expatriate community; with Diwali season nearing, travellers should allow extra transit time and keep plans flexible as floods disrupt roads while airports and city rail keep running.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Three Doctors Turn Delhi–Aizawl Flight Into a Flying Emergency Ward
news.excerpt: A passenger with chronic kidney disease suffered severe oxygen desaturation mid-flight — and three doctors travelling on board improvised a ward in the cabin until the plane landed in Aizawl.
news.image_caption: An Air India aircraft; the Delhi–Aizawl flight where three doctors attended to a passenger's mid-air medical emergency
news.nri_angle: For the diaspora flying long-haul to India with elderly parents or chronic conditions, this rescue is a reminder to keep medical records and prescriptions in cabin baggage and brief the cabin crew on boarding.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Jaishankar Calls US a 'Lonelier Power', Urges Middle Path Between America and China
news.excerpt: At the Munich Leaders Meeting, the external affairs minister said Washington had deliberately drifted, China is rising sharply, and middle powers must navigate between them with a 'Goldilocks' balance.
news.image_caption: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar, who described the US as a 'lonelier power' at the Munich Leaders Meeting
news.nri_angle: For the diaspora, this is the clearest articulation of the foreign-policy weather they live in: Jaishankar's balancing act between a repositioning America and an assertive China will shape the trade, technology and immigration policies that touch Indians abroad.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: IRDAI's Insurance Commission Overhaul Sparks Fears for One Million Brokers' Jobs
news.excerpt: The regulator wants to cap commissions and cut insurers' expense limits by a third; brokers say the maths will kill jobs and leave small-town customers unserved.
news.image_caption: A blue keyboard key labelled "insurance" with an umbrella icon on a white keyboard. IRDAI has proposed caps on insurance commissions and a one-third cut in insurers' expense limits, sparking a fight with the brokers' industry body over jobs.
news.nri_angle: For NRIs holding Indian life and health policies, the fight is worth watching: leaner distribution economics could mean cheaper premiums and cleaner sales practices, or thinner broker networks in smaller towns where insurance penetration is lowest.

nri-world.excerpt: The New Hampshire Tech Alliance honored the ePropelled founder at its October 6 Innovation Summit, capping a four-decade career that runs from Nashoba Networks to a global propulsion company with an engineering center in Chennai.
nri-world.image_caption: ePropelled founder and CEO Nick Grewal (left) poses with former New Hampshire Governor Chris Sununu. Grewal was named the New Hampshire Tech Alliance's 2026 Entrepreneur of the Year at its October 6 Innovation Summit in Nashua.
nri-world.nri_angle: ePropelled's engineering and development center in Chennai puts Indian engineers at the heart of a global propulsion-tech supply chain, linking Grewal's recognition directly to Indian tech talent.

nri-world.title: Brooklyn Comic Pooja Reddy Turns Kentucky Roots Into Country Cabaret
nri-world.excerpt: Her one-woman show "Pooja Reddy is White Trash" at Joe's Pub uses stand-up and original country songs to explore a South Indian upbringing in rural Kentucky.
nri-world.image_caption: The Public Theater on Lafayette Street in Manhattan, whose Joe's Pub venue hosted the premiere of Brooklyn comic Pooja Reddy's one-woman country cabaret, 'Pooja Reddy is White Trash,' this September.
nri-world.nri_angle: A second-generation Indian American turning a small-town Southern upbringing into art — Reddy's show speaks directly to diaspora kids raised far from any desi enclave, who grew up as the only brown face in the room.

nri-world.title: Krishnamoorthi Condemns 240% Surge in Anti-South Asian Hate Posts on X
nri-world.excerpt: The Illinois Democrat cited a new study counting 542,360 hateful posts targeting South Asians in 18 months, and named a Texas candidate's post and a DHS graphic as examples.
nri-world.image_caption: Rep. Raja Krishnamoorthi (D-Ill.), who condemned the surge in anti-South Asian hate posts on X.
nri-world.nri_angle: Directly about the South Asian American experience: a measurable 240% surge in online hate, tied by a leading Indian American lawmaker to mainstream political rhetoric — a civil-rights issue the community is being asked to confront publicly.

nri-world.title: Ghana to Seek BRICS Membership, Asks India's Backing During Jaishankar Visit
nri-world.excerpt: Ghana's cabinet has decided to pursue BRICS membership and asked New Delhi to guide its bid; the two sides also signed MoUs on agriculture and science and technology during the EAM's October 6–7 visit.
nri-world.image_caption: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar with Ghana's President John Mahama in Accra. Ghana is seeking India's backing for BRICS membership. (PTI)
nri-world.nri_angle: Ghana hosts one of West Africa's most established Indian business communities in trade, manufacturing, and pharmaceuticals — the exact sectors both governments prioritized, and a BRICS seat with Indian backing could ease the path for Indian firms operating there.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Flydubai Co-Pilot Confesses Gaza Revenge Motive, Had Planned Ben Gurion Crash
nri-world.excerpt: Hamam al-Hammami told investigators he sought an airline job to carry out the attack and wanted to die a martyr; investigators are now probing whether he acted alone, while Captain Smit Machchhar recovers from a fractured skull.
nri-world.image_caption: A Flydubai Boeing 737-800. Co-pilot Hamam al-Hammami allegedly planned to crash Flight FZ1073 into Ben Gurion Airport in revenge for Gaza.
nri-world.nri_angle: An Indian pilot's heroism saved Flight FZ1073, and his recovery continues; the case also spotlights aviation-security gaps that matter to the millions of Indians who fly Gulf routes every year.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: India's Young Astronomers Shine With Four Golds and a Silver in Hanoi
nri-world.excerpt: All five Indian students medalled at the 19th International Olympiad on Astronomy and Astrophysics, placing India joint third among 64 countries in the biggest IOAA ever held.
nri-world.image_caption: The Indian team holds the national flag at the 19th International Olympiad on Astronomy and Astrophysics in Hanoi, medals around their necks. All five students medalled — four golds and one silver — placing India joint third among 64 countries.
nri-world.nri_angle: The IOAA triumph gives diaspora families a concrete window into India's HBCSE Olympiad pipeline — the training system behind the medals and a path many Indian-origin students abroad try to emulate — while underscoring the strength of the science education system many diaspora careers were built on.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Chennai's Indian Fine Arts Society Honours Its Young Carnatic Stars
nri-world.excerpt: More than 20 children took prizes at the 93-year-old sabha's annual music competition, with top winners receiving Thanjavur tamburas at a ceremony in Alwarpet on Sunday.
nri-world.image_caption: Winners of the Indian Fine Arts Society's annual music competition pose with their prizes in Chennai. More than 20 children received prizes at the ceremony on Sunday.
nri-world.nri_angle: NRIs planning Margazhi-season trips to Chennai can catch this next generation of Carnatic musicians as they move from student competitions onto the December concert stage.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Rahul Gandhi Accuses Delhi Police of Silencing Women Over Harassment Complaints
nri-world.excerpt: The Leader of Opposition said women protesters and journalists faced mistreatment by Delhi Police during October 3 demonstrations at Jantar Mantar, and demanded CCTV footage from Saket police station be made public.
nri-world.image_caption: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi. Gandhi accused Delhi Police of silencing women over harassment complaints after meeting two journalists who alleged assault at Saket police station.
nri-world.nri_angle: Overseas Indians follow Indian political developments closely; the standoff adds another flashpoint to the SIR controversy and the broader debate over policing of protests and press freedom in the world's largest democracy.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Rahul Vohra: The ₹144 Crore LinkedIn Exit That Taught Him Balance
nri-world.excerpt: The British-Indian Superhuman co-founder sold Rapportive to LinkedIn for a reported $15 million months after collapsing from exhaustion. The health crisis rewired how he builds companies — and he has meditated twice daily ever since.
nri-world.image_caption: Rahul Vohra, founder of Superhuman and Rapportive. (yespress.io)
nri-world.nri_angle: Vohra's Birmingham-to-Silicon-Valley arc, and his public break with the diaspora's outwork-everyone script, give Indian-origin professionals in high-pressure roles a concrete founder-tested case for designing stamina instead of burning through it.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: San Jose Seventh-Grader Boosts Air-to-Water Output 117%, Reaches National STEM Final
nri-world.excerpt: Ankith Burki built an atmospheric water generator from scratch, found that low-frequency sound waves dramatically increased its water collection, and earned a finalist spot in the 2026 Thermo Fisher Scientific Junior Innovators Challenge.
nri-world.image_caption: San Jose seventh-grader Ankith Burki. His air-to-water prototype reached the national final of the 2026 Thermo Fisher Scientific Junior Innovators Challenge.
nri-world.nri_angle: For Indian-American families, Burki's achievement shows diaspora youth using STEM to tackle water scarcity — a problem with deep relevance to India, where water stress affects hundreds of millions.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: US Moves to Strip Citizenship From 40 People in Largest Denaturalization Push Yet
immigration.excerpt: The Justice Department filed 40 denaturalization cases between Aug. 21 and Oct. 2 against naturalized citizens accused of serious crimes and immigration fraud — the biggest such push in modern US history.
immigration.image_caption: A U.S. passport. The government has moved to strip citizenship from 40 people in the largest denaturalization drive in decades.
immigration.nri_angle: One Indian national is named among the 40 denaturalization targets, and the sweeping push puts the large Indian naturalized population and N-400 applicants on notice that concealment on immigration forms — however old — can now trigger loss of citizenship.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: September's Global Immigration Shifts: What Changed for Visa Seekers Worldwide
immigration.excerpt: From Australia's new skilled-visa priority rules to Japan's twentyfold permanent residence fee hike and a UK settlement overhaul on the horizon, September brought rule changes that directly affect Indian migrants.
immigration.image_caption: WR Immigration's September 2026 global immigration recap graphic. The recap covers rule changes in Canada, Australia, the United Kingdom, Japan, Saudi Arabia, New Zealand, and Thailand.
immigration.nri_angle: Australia's onshore-first processing favors Indian students and graduates already in the country, while the UK's coming earned-settlement overhaul could reshape ILR eligibility for thousands of Indians nearing five years of residence.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Montana Governor Lands in India to Rescue Lentil Exports Amid MAGA Backlash
immigration.excerpt: Governor Greg Gianforte is leading a 30-member delegation to India and Sri Lanka to rebuild the state's collapsed pulse trade, even as anti-India voices in his own party attack the trip.
immigration.image_caption: Montana Governor Greg Gianforte. He is leading a 30-plus member delegation to India and Sri Lanka, with reviving Montana's lentil exports to India the centerpiece of the trip.
immigration.nri_angle: The trip exposes a paradox for Indian Americans: anti-India voices demand the governor's impeachment while Montana's farm economy and universities actively court Indian consumers, students, and research ties.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Gold Coils Below $4,150 as Markets Await the Fed's Minutes
markets-finance.excerpt: Bullion slipped as the dollar and Treasury yields climbed, with traders pricing an 85% chance of a December rate hike ahead of the September FOMC minutes.
markets-finance.image_caption: A dollar symbol rests on a golden weighing pan. Gold eased to $4,150 an ounce on Wednesday as a stronger dollar and rising Treasury yields pressured the metal ahead of the Federal Reserve meeting minutes.
markets-finance.nri_angle: For Indian investors, the global pullback contrasts with strong domestic festive-season demand — with 24-karat gold around Rs 1.49 lakh per 10 grams in India, how much of that demand offsets macro headwinds will shape the metal's next move.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Nvidia Nears $6 Trillion on Record Highs and Biggest Buyback Ever
markets-finance.excerpt: Shares hit a record $239.11 as the AI chipmaker closes in on the first-ever $6 trillion market cap, powered by a $150 billion buyback and a $108 billion revenue outlook.
markets-finance.image_caption: Nvidia headquarters in Santa Clara, California. The AI chipmaker closed at a record high this week, pushing its market value toward $5.8 trillion.
markets-finance.nri_angle: For diaspora investors with US retirement accounts, Nvidia's roughly 7–8% weight in the S&P 500 means its swings land directly in index portfolios, whether or not they hold the stock itself.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Indian Banks Face a Q2 Paradox: FCNR Flood Boosts Loans, Squeezes Margins
markets-finance.excerpt: Brokerages expect Q2FY27 bank earnings to rise about 11%, powered by 18.8% credit growth and $127 billion of FCNR deposits — but the foreign-currency funding is set to shave 8–20 basis points off net interest margins.
markets-finance.image_caption: An HDFC Bank branch in India, with a pedestrian walking past the entrance. HDFC Bank grew deposits 19% year-on-year in Q2FY27, outpacing its loan growth of over 15%.
markets-finance.nri_angle: The $127 billion came from NRI pockets, and FCNR(B) deposits' foreign-currency denomination keeps depositors' returns free of rupee risk — though rates on fresh deposits are likely to soften as banks deploy the liquidity.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: World Bank Raises India's FY27 Growth Forecast to 7.1%, Flags AI as Next Driver
markets-finance.excerpt: The multilateral lender lifted its 2026/27 estimate by 50 basis points on resilient domestic demand, while warning that oil prices, El Niño and market volatility threaten the outlook.
markets-finance.image_caption: The World Bank Group logo displayed on a wall at the institution’s headquarters. The Bank on Tuesday raised India’s 2026/27 GDP growth forecast to 7.1% from 6.6%, citing resilient domestic demand and strong remittances.
markets-finance.nri_angle: The RBI is expected to raise rates on Oct 7 for the first time since 2023, which would lift NRE/NRO deposit yields for NRIs while raising borrowing costs in India; the World Bank also credits strong diaspora remittances as a pillar of India's resilient domestic demand.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Japanese Companies Exit China in Record Numbers as India Emerges as Alternative
markets-finance.excerpt: Teikoku Databank counts 10,118 Japanese companies in mainland China, down 30% from the 2012 peak, as firms shift investment toward India and Southeast Asia.
markets-finance.image_caption: The national flags of China and Japan appear side by side. Japanese companies have cut their presence in China to the lowest level since 2010, with 10,118 firms operating there as of June 2026, according to Teikoku Databank.
markets-finance.nri_angle: The pivot benefits India directly: Japanese manufacturers shifting capacity to India feed order books for industrial parks, logistics and suppliers — a concrete demand tailwind for India-focused investment portfolios.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Schneider Electric to Buy PTC for $22.6 Billion in Its Biggest Deal Ever
markets-finance.excerpt: The $205-a-share all-cash offer, a 42.3% premium, sent PTC shares up nearly 34% on Monday. Schneider's stock fell about 10% in Paris as investors weighed the price and the up-to-EUR-23-billion financing plan.
markets-finance.image_caption: Schneider Electric’s headquarters. The French engineering group agreed to acquire US industrial software company PTC for $22.6 billion in cash.
markets-finance.nri_angle: No direct impact for most readers, but the deal is another major bet on data-centre and industrial-AI infrastructure, a sector employing a large Indian tech workforce in the US and Europe.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: HDFC Bank Taps ICICI's Anup Bagchi as CEO With Stock Down 27% in 2026
markets-finance.excerpt: RBI approved Anup Bagchi's appointment as MD and CEO for a three-year term from October 27, 2026, ending months of succession uncertainty. Jefferies reaffirmed HDFC Bank as its top Indian pick with a Rs 880 target, even as the stock sits 27% below its 2025 close.
markets-finance.image_caption: An HDFC Bank branch. The bank has named ICICI's Anup Bagchi as its next CEO, starting October 19, 2026.
markets-finance.nri_angle: NRIs holding HDB ADRs or Indian bank ETFs have absorbed a 27% slide in 2026; an external CEO with a retail-franchise track record offers a reset narrative, though execution risk is real.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: India Tops Global SIP Returns: 74% of 5-Year Periods Beat 8% Mark
markets-finance.excerpt: DSP Asset Managers' 30-year, 16-country study found India the most rewarding market for systematic investors — though recent five-year Nifty SIP returns of ~4.5% show the average hides deep swings.
markets-finance.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange in Mumbai. Indian SIP investors saw strong five-year returns.
markets-finance.nri_angle: For NRIs comparing India with other markets, India's SIP edge in the DSP data is nominal — higher inflation and currency moves eat into it — while SPIVA data showing 84% of large-cap funds trailing benchmarks argues for low-cost index SIPs over active fund-picking.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: US Student Loan Defaults Hit $234 Billion — and Collections May Restart
markets-finance.excerpt: Federal data through June 30 shows 9.3 million borrowers in default — up from 7.7 million six months earlier — as the Trump administration keeps involuntary collections paused while it stands up a new support system.
markets-finance.image_caption: A chart of US consumer and government debt, including student loans. (Wikimedia Commons)
markets-finance.nri_angle: Indian students and recent graduates financing US degrees through federal loans face the same garnishment and credit consequences as any borrower — and the new repayment plans launched in July matter to anyone holding F-1 OPT-era debt.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Jio IPO Likely by October-End at $143-146 Billion Valuation
markets-finance.excerpt: Banking sources say Jio Platforms' estimated $3.8 billion public offering — potentially India's largest IPO — could list by month-end, with an anchor round before Dussehra and final SEBI filings in the week starting October 12.
markets-finance.nri_angle: At $143-146 billion the valuation is legible to diaspora investors in global terms; NRIs with demat accounts can apply for Indian IPOs on the same terms as residents.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: India Within Striking Distance of 8% Growth, Says PMO's Shaktikanta Das
markets-finance.excerpt: The former RBI governor credited a decade of reforms — GST, banking clean-up, inflation targeting, digital payments — for 7.8% June-quarter growth, and named AI the next productivity frontier.
markets-finance.image_caption: Shaktikanta Das, principal secretary to the prime minister and former RBI governor, at the Kautilya Economic Conclave in New Delhi
markets-finance.nri_angle: The domestic-demand growth story underpins the NRI investment case — steady remittances, services surplus and deepening capital markets keep the macro backdrop for diaspora portfolios supportive.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Pramod Bhagat, Bhavina Patel to Lead India at Asian Para Games
sports.excerpt: The two Tokyo Paralympic medallists will carry the tricolour at the opening ceremony in Nagoya as India sends 121 athletes to the October 18–24 Games.
sports.image_caption: Para-badminton star Pramod Bhagat, Tokyo 2020 Paralympic gold medallist, will carry India's flag alongside table-tennis medallist Bhavina Patel at the Aichi-Nagoya 2026 Asian Para Games opening ceremony.
sports.nri_angle: The Indian diaspora in Japan gets a rare home-soil chance to support the country's para-athletes in person at the Aichi-Nagoya Games.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Sujeet Kalkal's Comeback From 2-9 Down Wins Asian Games Wrestling Gold
sports.excerpt: The 23-year-old Indian beat Tajikistan's Abdulmazhid Kudiev 10-9 in the men's 65kg freestyle final at Aichi-Nagoya on October 2, ending India's eight-year wait for an Asian Games wrestling gold.
sports.image_caption: Sujeet Kalkal celebrates with the Indian tricolor after his Asian Games victory. The 23-year-old fought back from 2-9 down to beat Tajikistan's Abdulmazhid Kudiev 10-9 in the men's 65kg freestyle final at Aichi-Nagoya on October 2.
sports.nri_angle: A 23-year-old from Bhiwani's stunning comeback ended an eight-year gold drought — the kind of underdog sporting moment that rallies the global Indian diaspora around the tricolor.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: The Big Sister Who Taught India to Win: Harmanpreet Kaur's Captaincy Legacy
sports.excerpt: Harmanpreet Kaur stepped down after 14 years as India women's captain, leaving behind the country's first senior ICC title and a winning culture that will outlast her.
sports.image_caption: Harmanpreet Kaur, who stepped down this week as India women captain — the most successful captain in women's T20I history with 77 wins.
sports.nri_angle: Harmanpreet Kaur stepped down as India women's captain, closing a 14-year leadership era crowned by the 2025 ODI World Cup title and the most T20I wins of any captain in history.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Smriti Mandhana Named India Women's Full-Time Captain as Harmanpreet Steps Down
sports.excerpt: The BCCI named Mandhana all-format captain hours after Harmanpreet Kaur stood down following the Asian Games gold; Shafali Verma and Deepti Sharma are the new vice-captains.
sports.image_caption: Smriti Mandhana and Shafali Verma of the India women's cricket team during a match. Mandhana was named full-time captain on Tuesday, with Verma appointed as her T20I vice-captain.
sports.nri_angle: Mandhana is one of the most followed Indian sportswomen globally; her elevation is a landmark moment for young diaspora fans who have watched women's cricket move to prime time.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Shreyas Iyer's Maiden T20I Ton Powers India to Eight-Wicket Win Over West Indies
sports.excerpt: The India captain's unbeaten 102 off 43 balls — the first T20I hundred by an Indian skipper in a run chase — sealed an eight-wicket win with 32 balls to spare in Lucknow.
sports.image_caption: Shreyas Iyer raises his bat and helmet after reaching his maiden T20I century. His unbeaten 102 off 43 balls powered India to an eight-wicket win over West Indies in the series opener at Lucknow.
sports.nri_angle: A record-setting night for India's T20 captain, delivered hours after the squad returned from Asian Games gold — the kind of statement win diaspora fans watch for as the team builds toward the next World Cup cycle.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Neeru Dhanda Leads India's Sign-Off as Asian Games Close in Aichi-Nagoya
sports.excerpt: Trap shooter Neeru Dhanda, with two golds and a silver, carried the tricolour at Nagoya's Mizuho Park Stadium as India finished fourth with 85 medals — its second-best Asian Games tally.
sports.image_caption: The Mizuho Park Athletic Stadium in Nagoya hosted the closing ceremony of the 2026 Asian Games. Trap shooter Neeru Dhanda, who won two gold medals and a silver, carried India's tricolour as flag-bearer.
sports.nri_angle: India's 85-medal finish gives diaspora communities a shared moment of national sporting pride — the shooting, cricket and golf golds resonating with Indian-origin sports fans worldwide.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Pragyan Ojha Takes Interim Charge as BCCI Chief Selector After Agarkar Exit
sports.excerpt: With Ajit Agarkar's contract expiring October 4, the BCCI asked senior-most selector Pragyan Ojha — a 24-Test veteran — to take charge; he is also a leading candidate for the permanent role.
sports.image_caption: Pragyan Ojha takes interim charge as BCCI chief selector after Ajit Agarkar's departure.
sports.nri_angle: India's chief selector shapes the team the global diaspora follows most closely — and the permanent appointment will determine who picks the 2027 World Cup squad, the most-watched Indian team event of the decade for overseas fans.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: India Take on West Indies in Lucknow as T20I Series Begins Tuesday
sports.excerpt: The first of five T20Is starts at 7 p.m. IST on October 6 at Lucknow's Ekana Stadium, with Shreyas Iyer leading a young Indian side against Shai Hope's West Indies. Star Sports and JioHotstar carry the game in India; Willow TV streams it in the US.
sports.image_caption: The BCCI and West Indies Cricket logos on a series graphic. India and the West Indies open a five-match T20I series at Lucknow's Ekana Stadium on October 6, with Shreyas Iyer leading India and Shai Hope captaining the visitors.
sports.nri_angle: US-based fans can catch the 7 p.m. IST start at 9:30 a.m. ET / 6:30 a.m. PT on Willow TV, as a new-look India auditions its next T20 generation against the West Indies.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: With Asian Games Gold Secured, India Hockey Eyes Los Angeles 2028
sports.excerpt: India's men defended their Asian Games hockey title with a 5-1 win over Malaysia, the women ended a 44-year wait against China, and both squads have booked direct tickets to LA 2028.
sports.image_caption: India's men's hockey team celebrates with gold medals behind an LA 2028 'Qualified' banner. The 5-1 win over Malaysia in the Asian Games final was India's first successful title defence and booked a direct Olympic berth.
sports.nri_angle: LA 2028 lets Indian-Americans watch India chase Olympic hockey gold on home soil for the first time, with both the men's and women's teams qualified directly.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Archery Premier League Returns to Hyderabad as Asian Games Stars Turn Rivals
sports.excerpt: Less than a week after India won nine Asian Games archery medals, the stars trade national jerseys for franchise rivalries in the Archery Premier League's second season, running October 8–18 in Hyderabad.
sports.image_caption: The Archery Premier League logo. Season 2 of the franchise archery league begins in Hyderabad on October 8, with 48 archers across six teams competing over 11 days.
sports.nri_angle: The APL gives Indian fans abroad a new way to follow archery — and an early look at the archers India will field at Los Angeles 2028, which many in the US diaspora will attend.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Hardik Pandya Trade Back on Table as Franchise Makes Fresh Inquiry
sports.excerpt: Cricbuzz reports renewed franchise interest in the Mumbai Indians captain, with the next three to four weeks likely decisive — but MI publicly insists no trade talks are on until its post-season review is done.
sports.image_caption: Hardik Pandya in a Mumbai Indians training kit. The 32-year-old all-rounder’s IPL future is the subject of renewed trade speculation ahead of the November 15 retention deadline.
sports.nri_angle: A Pandya trade would redraw IPL loyalties for the diaspora's watch-party and fantasy-league audience overnight — the debate among Indian-origin fans is already about fit, not money.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Diego Forlan Warns Uruguay: Be Careful Against India's Young Talent
sports.excerpt: Ahead of Tuesday's historic India-Uruguay friendly in Kolkata, the 2010 World Cup Golden Ball winner says the Blue Tigers have "a lot of young footballing talent" — but need a stronger league and academies to develop them.
sports.image_caption: Diego Forlán, head coach of Uruguay, at the pre-match press conference in Kolkata. He is in India ahead of Uruguay’s historic friendly against the Blue Tigers at Salt Lake Stadium on Tuesday.
sports.nri_angle: Forlan's insider verdict — talent is abundant, pathways are not — speaks directly to diaspora football families weighing where a young player's serious career can be built.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Google Brings Gemini AI to Chrome on Android for Indian Users
technology.excerpt: The in-browser assistant summarises pages, answers questions about what’s on screen and connects with Google apps — while the new agentic Auto Browse feature arrives restricted to paid subscribers.
technology.nri_angle: Family in India gets the same AI-assisted browsing the US has had, and desktop’s eight Indian-language support means parents who prefer Hindi or Tamil can use it — relevant for diaspora households bridging the two.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Gradiant Wins Five India Contracts as Chip Boom Turns on Water
technology.excerpt: The Boston water-technology company named a new India chief and will expand its Indian workforce by more than 40 percent as it supplies ultrapure water and zero-liquid-discharge systems to semiconductor, circuit-board and solar factories.
technology.image_caption: Precision equipment works on a semiconductor wafer during chip fabrication. Gradiant won five new contracts to supply ultrapure water and zero-liquid-discharge systems to chip, circuit-board and solar factories in India.
technology.nri_angle: Gradiant's expansion adds deep-tech engineering roles in India — including at its Coimbatore center that serves global projects — at the intersection of the country's chip ambitions and diaspora tech careers.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: CDK Global Taps Indian-Origin Veteran Sudhakar Ramakrishna as CEO
technology.excerpt: Ramakrishna, former SolarWinds chief executive, succeeds Brian MacDonald at the Brookfield-owned automotive retail software company, taking charge on October 5 as CDK pushes its AI-driven dealership platform.
technology.image_caption: Sudhakar Ramakrishna, newly named president and CEO of CDK Global. He took charge on October 5, 2026, succeeding Brian MacDonald, and will lead the automotive retail software provider's AI-driven platform push.
technology.nri_angle: Ramakrishna's rise from a Kansas State computer-science master's to the CEO's office at a major U.S. software company adds another Indian-origin name to the top ranks of global enterprise technology.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: ElevenLabs to Invest Hundreds of Millions in India, Eyes Acquisitions
technology.excerpt: The $22 billion voice-AI company's India bet: local teams, Indian-language models, and possible acquisitions — with India already its biggest market by signups.
technology.image_caption: ElevenLabs, the AI voice company, plans to invest hundreds of millions of dollars in India, co-founder Mati Staniszewski told Reuters.
technology.nri_angle: India's voice-AI economy: $1M+ paid to Indian voice talent, 500+ Indian startups on free APIs, and an expanding India hiring push as a $22B global AI lab makes the country a core investment destination.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: QOSMIC's ARGUS Patent: Bengaluru Startup Wins US Patent for Laser-Communication Ground Station
technology.excerpt: QOSMIC Satellite Systems won a US patent on September 8 for ARGUS, a multi-aperture optical ground station for satellite laser communications — technology the startup says was conceived, engineered and validated in India.
technology.image_caption: An optical ground station telescope like QOSMIC's ARGUS, designed to receive laser communications from satellites
technology.nri_angle: QOSMIC's US patent is a signal for the diaspora that Bengaluru's deep-tech ecosystem is producing frontier space-communications IP — with NRI engineers, researchers and investors increasingly part of that loop as investors, collaborators and talent.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Bengaluru Engineer Builds AI App That Turns Potholes Into Accountable Complaints
technology.excerpt: Gaurav Sen's open-source Pothole Reporter matches dashcam-detected road damage to government contracts and drafts a ready-to-send complaint — photo, location, and tender reference — in about four seconds.
technology.image_caption: Commuters ride over a badly damaged, pothole-ridden road in Bengaluru. Engineer Gaurav Sen's open-source Pothole Reporter app detects such road damage and drafts evidence-backed complaints to civic authorities in about four seconds.
technology.nri_angle: NRIs who drive Indian roads on visits home can use the free, open-source tool to file documented complaints, and its code is a replicable template for civic accountability anywhere.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: IIM Ahmedabad Gold Medallist Shubham Goyal Leads a 13-Member Team at Microsoft
technology.excerpt: The IIM-A graduate — Institute Rank 1 in his first year among 393 students, with the best overall GPA in the institute's MBA history — now leads a 13-member team at the software giant after patenting AI product work as a project lead.
technology.image_caption: A portrait photograph of Shubham Goyal. The IIM Ahmedabad gold medallist now leads a 13-member team at Microsoft, where he has served as project lead on patented AI work.
technology.nri_angle: For Indian professionals and students abroad, Goyal's rise is a concrete example of Indian-educated talent leading AI product work inside the world's largest software firms.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: India Funds Deep-Tech Startups Lavishly but Rarely Buys From Them
technology.excerpt: Startups got less than 4 per cent of the Rs 5.03 lakh crore the government spent on GeM in FY26 — exposing the missing half of India's startup policy: public procurement.
technology.image_caption: An ISRO SSLV rocket lifts off. Defence and space procurement broke through only after the state changed how it buys, via iDEX and the SSLV transfer to HAL.
technology.nri_angle: For diaspora engineers, founders and investors watching India from the US and Europe, procurement — not funding — is the variable that decides whether a deep-tech bet in India scales into a global company.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Indian Startup Funding Slips 8% in September Even as Big Deals Land
technology.excerpt: VC inflows hit $1.139 billion in September, down 8.3% from a year earlier but up 15.5% from August, as four $100-million-plus deals propped up the month, according to YourStory Research.
technology.image_caption: A photo illustration of a coin jar labeled VCs with coins flowing from a tap. Indian startups raised $1.139 billion in venture funding in September, down 8.3% from a year earlier, according to YourStory Research.
technology.nri_angle: For NRI founders and investors watching from the US, September's early-stage tilt — $557 million into young startups — is the signal that seed-stage India remains open for business even as late-stage capital stays selective.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: OpenAI to Add Invisible Text Watermarks to ChatGPT and Codex in the EU
technology.excerpt: OpenAI's textGrain system subtly shapes word choices so detectors can spot AI-generated text, complying with the EU AI Act. API developers worldwide can opt in; the detector stays limited to approved researchers.
technology.image_caption: The ChatGPT app icon on a smartphone. OpenAI said it will add an invisible statistical watermark to eligible ChatGPT and Codex text in the European Union over the coming weeks.
technology.nri_angle: No change for users outside the EU — watermarking is EU-only and opt-in on the API — but educators, employers and compliance teams should know these marks are invisible, fragile and often absent.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: First Microblazar Found in Milky Way: Black Hole Jet Aimed at Earth
technology.excerpt: IRAS 18293−0941, a stellar-mass black hole 12,000 light-years away firing plasma at 75% light speed toward Earth, is the first confirmed microblazar — and a 100-times-more-powerful natural accelerator than the LHC.
technology.image_caption: Artist impression of microblazar IRAS 18293−0941, with one jet aimed almost at Earth (left) and the other striking a molecular cloud. The system, 12,000 light-years away, is the first confirmed microblazar in the Milky Way. Illustration: B. Marcote (JIVE/ASTRON).
technology.nri_angle: India's radio astronomers regularly join multi-observatory campaigns like this one, and the GMRT near Pune shares survey skies with MeerKAT, whose images confirmed the microblazar's counter-jet hotspot.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: India Demonstrates First Free-Space Quantum Link Over 5.56 km of Air
technology.excerpt: QNu Labs' overnight trial between BISAG-N and IIT Gandhinagar transmitted secure encryption keys through open air with an error rate below 5%, laying the groundwork for satellite-based quantum communication.
technology.image_caption: Laboratory equipment for quantum key distribution research, including server racks, fibre-optic spools and monitoring displays. QNu Labs demonstrated Indias first free-space QKD link over 5.56 km of open air between BISAG-N and IIT Gandhinagar on the night of Sept. 27-28.
technology.nri_angle: The quantum-encrypted systems that will eventually secure UPI payments and NRI remittances are being tested and owned domestically; the diaspora's financial links to India will rest on this indigenous stack.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: The Traitors Telugu Trailer Out

lifestyle-health.title: India Well-Prepared for Plague, but Early Diagnosis Is Key, Expert Says
lifestyle-health.excerpt: After a suspected pneumonic plague death in Siberia rattled global headlines, IMA Research Cell convenor Dr Rajeev Jayadevan told ANI there is no immediate threat to India — and urged vigilance over alarm.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: A fluorescent micrograph of Yersinia pestis, the bacterium that causes plague. A suspected pneumonic plague death in Russia's Irkutsk region has put global health watchers on alert.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: Indian travellers and the diaspora in Russia need not panic over the Siberian case — experts say severe pneumonic plague patients are rarely well enough to travel far, and India runs dedicated plague surveillance at home.

lifestyle-health.title: Pomegranate Compound May Improve Stiff-Heart Failure, Study Finds
lifestyle-health.excerpt: King's College London researchers found that urolithin A, made by gut bacteria after eating pomegranates, improved heart function up to 80% in animal models of stiff-heart failure by activating a key relaxation protein.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: A close-up of pomegranate seeds. Researchers at Kings College London found that urolithin A, produced by gut bacteria after eating pomegranates, improved heart function in animal models of stiff-heart failure.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: Pomegranate is a familiar staple in Indian kitchens and Ayurvedic tradition, making this study culturally resonant — though the honest read is that it validates a biochemical pathway, not a traditional remedy.

lifestyle-health.title: Indian Mom Harshana Loses 32 Kg in 11 Months, Quits Five Everyday Foods
lifestyle-health.excerpt: Gurugram-based work-from-home mother Deepti Harshana shared the everyday foods she quit — sugary drinks, white bread, packaged snacks, fried food and late-night snacking — alongside hydration, sleep and daily walking.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: Roasted makhana, nuts and other simple swaps that powered Deepti Harshana's 32 kg weight-loss journey
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: For Indian-American readers, Harshana's quit-list reads like a diaspora pantry inventory — packaged namkeen, white bread, sugary drinks — and her swaps (makhana, roasted chana, home-cooked tikkas) are already familiar, making the habit changes easy to trial at home.
